message.content:
To log in to your **My Service Canada Account (MSCA)**, follow these steps:

## How to Access My Service Canada Account

### Step 1: Go to the Official MSCA Login Page
Visit the official Government of Canada MSCA page at **https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html**

### Step 2: Choose Your Sign-In Method
You have **three options** to log in:

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| **GCKey** | A Government of Canada electronic credential (username and password) |
| **Sign-In Partner (Bank)** | Use your existing online banking credentials from participating financial institutions (RBC, TD, Scotiabank, BMO, CIBC, National Bank, Desjardins, etc.) |
| **Provincial Digital ID** | Available only for residents of **Alberta** and **British Columbia** |

### Step 3: Complete Multi-Factor Authentication
As of recent security updates, you must register for **multi-factor authentication** when signing in with GCKey or your bank (Sign-In Partner). This helps protect your account from unauthorized access.

### Step 4: Access Your Dashboard
Once logged in, you'll see your MSCA dashboard where you can access:
- Employment Insurance (EI)
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP)
- Old Age Security (OAS)
- Canadian Dental Care Plan (CDCP)
- Social Insurance Number (SIN) information
- Tax slips (T4E, T4A)
- Direct deposit settings

---

## Important Notes

- **New to MSCA?** If you haven't registered yet, you'll need to complete registration first, which may require a **Personal Access Code (PAC)** sent by mail (takes 5-10 business days).
- **Student loan users:** As of May 25, 2025, the National Student Loans Service Centre (NSLSC) now uses MSCA as the access point for student loan servicing.
- **Security:** Service Canada will never ask for your password or personal information via email or text messages.

---

## Need Help?
- **GCKey issues:** Visit the GCKey help page or contact GCKey support
- **Forgot your PAC:** Request a new one through Service Canada
- **Account locked:** Contact Service Canada directly for assistance

---

Sources:
1. https://www.canada.ca/en/employment-social-development/services/my-account.html
2. https://srv136.services.gc.ca/ECAS-SECA/RASCL/Support/HelpPage.aspx?rurl=/ecas-seca/rascl/SCL/Authentication.aspx
3. https://www.insurdinary.ca/my-service-canada-account-guide/
4. https://allreview.ca/blog/canadian-resources/what-is-my-service-canada-account/
5. https://welcomeaide.com/en/blog/how-to-use-service-canada-online
